method: 14 sampled frames across the clip; final native frame additionally inspected for shots 08 and 12; AVFoundation decode and audio level checks.
observations: Road markings, intersections and buildings move past the camera; the shot contains forward travel rather than only a static image with blur.
Arms alternate in and out of frame, and cyan speed streaks build toward the end.
limitations: The perceived speed and running rhythm need real-time playback against the music. Sampled frames do not establish a physical speed.
Dense streaks dominate the ending; the final cut may need a shorter range and controlled effects.
Review used 14 sampled frames plus technical decoding; no full real-time playback or independent listening review. Native audio is preserved and needs sound-design/mix review.
